name: watch-and-control-plus
title: Watch and Control Plus
author: bespoked
description: The full remote-eyes setup. Two camera views (the printer's built-in camera and a USB camera you plug in), hardware video acceleration so both streams stay off the CPU, the Remote Screen mirror that puts the printer's touchscreen in your browser and sends your taps back, and Timelapse, which turns the print into a video you can watch afterwards. Everything appears in Fluidd and Mainsail with no manual setup.
tagline: Two cameras, the printer's touchscreen, and a timelapse of every print.
